Scope. The 4 September review cut video to edits and ads. VID-EDIT-* and VID-AD-* are in scope; VID-I2V-* share the image_to_video task but sit outside it. Counting VID-AD-09 (text-to-video, already runnable), the in-scope set is 18 of 20 runnable — VID-EDIT-10 has no source clip and VID-EDIT-02 is retired.
